---
title: User guide
---

The [tutorials](../tutorials/index.qmd) show how to run FPsim. This user guide covers the
two areas where users most often need to go further: fitting the model to a setting, and
changing what contraceptive methods exist and who uses them.

- **[Calibration](calibration/index.qmd)** -- what FPsim fits, how mismatch is computed,
  and how to recalibrate a location.
- **[Contraception](contraception/index.qmd)** -- how methods are defined, how choice is
  modeled, and how to introduce a new method.

Each section starts with an explanation of how the mechanism works, followed by how-to
topics for specific tasks.
